scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/ai"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/ai
scripts.vercel-build: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate && cd ../.. && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/ai
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/shared
